title: Balanced Binary CNOT Tree (Depth log_2 h) vs. Linear Star (Depth h-1) Idle Decoherence Suppression
claims: For any power-of-2 witness weight h = 2^d, both the linear CNOT star and the balanced binary fan-in CNOT tree use exactly h - 1 CNOT gates and project the all-zero syndrome d = 0^{h-1} onto the identical 2-dimensional subspace span{|0^h>, |1^h>}.

Reducing circuit depth from h - 1 to log_2(h) cuts total qubit-layer idle volume from h*(h-1) to h*log_2(h), boosting coherence visibility by exp(alpha_idle * h * (h - 1 - log_2(h))) (>5.81x at h=16, alpha_idle=0.01).
